unit: nlm-regrade (Task B: all adapters re-graded with one record per test example; this is the run of record for the Task B live test)
what: No training. Six adapters are scored on the frozen test text with the log-likelihood grader, which writes one record per test example (true labels, the log-likelihood of every candidate at the family, cause and action stage, the choice made), the SHA-256 of every adapter file and of the test text, and copies the records to the evidence bucket from inside the job: the untuned base (initial adapter), the two local-only adapters and the central adapter (ran-nlm-baselines-20261102T090507), the final federated adapter of ran-nlm-fed-20261102T0911, and the final federated adapter of the replicate session ran-nlm-fed-rep2-20261102T1149. An earlier attempt, ran-nlm-rescore-20261102T115301, stopped after the first adapter (HTTP 403 reading an S3 prefix the job role cannot read) and is kept as a failed attempt.

target.metric: family confusion counts of every model, site and true family
target.value: identical to the original scoring jobs for the five adapters scored before (ran-nlm-baselines-20261102T090507 and ran-nlm-fed-score-20261102T093824)
target.direction: exact match expected (same code path, same hardware class). Any difference is reported in GAPS.md, not hidden, and the per-example records become the reported numbers. For the replicate adapter the target is the one declared in ran-nlm-fed-rep2-20261102T1149: family accuracy of at least 0.85 on the family each site never logged, reported next to the first run, which is not replaced.

model_id: OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (organisers' bucket) + LoRA r=8 alpha=16 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; ran-fl/taskb/model-code/model.py
grader: ran-fl/taskb/taskb_job.py (deterministic: log-likelihood ranking of the candidate FAMILY, CAUSE and ACTION; no model-written labels, no LLM judge)
